name: Weighted Max-Cut Benchmark
description: Extended Max-Cut benchmark using weighted graph instances, which present a harder optimization landscape than the standard unweighted variant. Weighted instances introduce a proliferation of poor local optima and exacerbate barren-plateau issues. Recent work compares QAOA with non-variational quantum walk algorithms on weighted instances up to 31 nodes.
significance: Demonstrates that weighted instances are substantially harder than unweighted MaxCut, with barren plateaus and local optima proliferating in the optimization landscape.

news.title: Benchmarking Quantum Heuristics: Non-Variational QWOA for Weighted Maxcut
news.excerpt: Benchmarking results for non-variational Quantum Walk Optimisation Algorithm applied to weighted maxcut using classical simulations for problem sizes up to n=31. Results show constant average-case measurement probability for globally optimal solutions and suggest favorable scaling compared to classical heuristics.
